title: Feature pipeline result
description: Machine-readable verdict for one /feature run, so the pipeline can branch without parsing prose. The human-readable review packet still arrives in the `result` field alongside this.

status.description: completed = the change is implemented in the working tree and every gate the skill ran has passed. Report completed even though nothing is committed: the pipeline commits and pushes for you, and Stage 8 forbids you from doing it yourself, so an uncommitted working tree is the expected end state and never a reason to report blocked. blocked = the change itself could not be produced (a gate that could not be made to pass, two failed verifier rounds, a dirty tree at Stage 0). too-large = Stage 2 refused to build it in one pass and proposed a split.

summary.description: One paragraph, plain language: what changed and why.

blockedReason.description: Present only when status is blocked or too-large. What stopped the run, in one or two sentences.

filesChanged.description: Repo-relative paths actually modified. Empty when nothing was written.

build.description: Result of `npm run build`, with real output, e.g. "passed" or the first error.

test.description: Result of `npm test` with real numbers, e.g. "42 passed, 0 failed".

lint.description: Result of `npm run lint`. The 4 pre-existing App.tsx warnings are the accepted baseline; say so rather than reporting them as failures.

visual.description: visual-verifier's verdict, present only when it ran. Include the computed values it measured, not just PASS.

visualSkippedBecause.description: Present only when the change renders nothing and visual-verifier was therefore not run. Name what you considered.

needsHumanEyes.description: Genuine judgment calls left for the reviewer, already narrowed by what the machine settled. Do not list checks a gate has done. Empty array if there are none.

assumptions.description: Unknowns the analyst raised that were resolved without asking, each with the one-line reasoning. This is the list a reviewer scans first.

commitMessage.description: Subject line only, imperative mood, no trailing period. Used verbatim as the commit subject and PR title.
